purpose: Freeze a finite seven-route prevalue review of issuer-as-freight, parcel, express or logistics operator shipment booking, waybill, pickup, induction, sortation, transfer, linehaul, last-mile delivery, exception, return, claim, billing and settlement states before any source row, formula, direction, candidate value, comparator, security price or return is read.

adjacent_mentions_only: generic shipment volume and customer-service KPIs
vessel fleet, charter and freight-rate states

requirements: lawful public or licensed point-in-time source with first-available, correction and supersession timestamps mapped to accepted trading sessions

stable issuer, listed-parent, operating-subsidiary, network, service-product, privacy-safe shipper cohort, shipment, parcel, waybill, container, route-token, hub, delivery-attempt, claim, invoice and settlement identities without current-state projection

complete 2019-2023 applicable denominators including quoted, booked, cancelled, uncollected, accepted, delayed, misrouted, damaged, lost, refused, returned, disputed, unresolved and structurally inapplicable states
explicit missing, suppressed, corrected and genuine-zero semantics without filling non-logistics issuers or uncovered shipment states with zero
no directly identifiable sender or recipient, address, phone, payment credential, precise live route, sensitive cargo description, access credential or reidentifiable shipment record

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: freight_quote_booking_order_waybill_label_pickup_acceptance_cancel_expiry_and_uncollected_stock_flow_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time source preserves operator, service, privacy-safe shipper cohort, order, shipment, parcel and waybill identities; every quote, booking, label, pickup request, acceptance, cancellation, expiry and failed or uncollected transition; correction clocks; and the complete applicable denominator.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: freight_induction_sortation_transfer_linehaul_customs_hub_arrival_last_mile_attempt_delivery_exception_reroute_return_and_proof_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a lawful deidentified event history linking induction, sortation, transfer, linehaul, customs or regulatory hold, hub arrival, out-for-delivery, attempt, proof, refusal, damage, loss, reroute and return transitions across all successful, failed, pending and unresolved shipments.

finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source preserves deidentified shipment obligations, measured weight and dimension, rated freight, surcharge, cash-on-delivery reconciliation, invoices, adjustments, collections, damage or loss claims, denials, appeals, compensation, refunds and settlements with revisions, first-availability clocks and unresolved denominators.

finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Pricing, leases, productive assets, licenses and shipping-fleet employment are terminal adjacent states and cannot reconstruct parcel-level pickup, sortation, linehaul, last-mile, return, claim and billing execution.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: supplier_customer_inventory_goods_in_transit_passenger_journey_waste_pickup_payment_transaction_or_support_ticket_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Campaign163, 195, 196, 199, 203 and 206 govern different identities and clocks; their records cannot be relabelled as a complete freight or parcel shipment event, custody, delivery, return, claim and settlement history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: transport_mode_route_origin_destination_service_level_shipper_cohort_cargo_class_direction_threshold_age_window_subset_combination_or_model_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Selecting a mode, route, geography, service level, shipper cohort, cargo class, direction, threshold, age, window, subset, weight, interaction or model before complete lawful base histories are admitted would multiply hypotheses and exploit privacy, network, exception, correction and operator survivorship.

scientific_interpretation: Freight and parcel execution is economically distinct from vessel ownership, passenger journeys, goods-in-transit accounting, waste collection, payment and support states, but distinction alone does not admit a factor. The absent complete lawful point-in-time shipment source is the binding gate.
next_action: Bind all seven routes and all Campaign209 infrastructure failures into one append-only ledger, publish terminal prevalue evidence, and authorize a genuinely different Campaign210 domain.
